about: Variables suggested by commentary and comms, measured in every stored replay (comms_vars.py). Intervals: 90% from resampling whole matches. Verdict: supported / contradicted when the interval excludes zero, else unclear.

solo_monk.measure: groups of 3+ players facing enemies in a phase: one healer against two or more, same local numbers; outcome = the group lost a player in that phase
solo_monk.source: OG comms [ohno v One], [ohno v NwAy]: calls of 'solo monk' as the moment to commit (go on the monk)

no_healer_group.measure: groups of 2+ facing enemies in a phase: no healer against at least one, same local numbers; outcome = lost a player
no_healer_group.source: OG comms [ohno v One]: keep a prot and a monk on one side and the Rit and a monk on the other at all times

spread.measure: players in a fight every 5 s: nearest ally under 150 units (tight) against farther, same local numbers; outcome = died within 10 s; split by whether the enemy has 2+ elementalists (area damage)
spread.source: OG comms [ohno v Fun], [OG v cope J]: 'spread out' against invoke and Ele spikes

strip_on_spike.measure: spikes (400+ in 3 s): an enchantment removal by the spiking team finished on the target from 2 s before the first hit to 1 s after; outcome = the target died within 8 s; compared within the number of spikers
strip_on_spike.source: OG comms [ohno v Crew]: 'double Shatter kills'

armor_on_spike.measure: spikes (400+ in 3 s): the target had Cracked Armor at the first hit; outcome = the target died within 8 s; compared within the number of spikers
armor_on_spike.source: OG comms [OG v cope J]: land Shell Shock between 'two' and 'one' of the countdown

hexed_spikers.measure: spikes (400+ in 3 s): at least one spiker carried a hex at the first hit; outcome = the target died within 8 s; compared within the number of spikers
hexed_spikers.source: OG comms [OG v cope J], [OG v hdm]: Migraine not covered on a spiker, 'why are we not killing'

low_morale.measure: players in a fight every 5 s: death penalty 15% or more against none; outcome = died within 10 s; same local numbers
low_morale.source: OG comms [ohno v One]: their warrior has 30 DP, we could just fight him

merge.measure: groups in the enemy pit or base: 7+ players against 3 to 6; outcome = killed a player in that phase (and, separately, lost one)
merge.source: OG comms [ohno v Crew]: whoever called to merge, we ended way earlier

turtle.measure: a team with 75%+ of its live players in its own base or pit for 60 s straight (5+ alive), with no deaths in the 2 minutes before (so not just resurrected); what the next 90 s held and who won
turtle.verdict: descriptive (the win-model candidate turtle_diff tests it on unseen matches)
turtle.source: OG comms [ohno v One], [ohno v Crew]: they are turtling, so we have to make a play; if they get a kill it may break the turtle

portal.measure: Isle of Solitude: a player moving 2,500+ units in one recorded second (a portal jump)
portal.verdict: descriptive (too few Solitude matches to test)
portal.source: OG comms [ohno v One], [ohno v Fun]: fake a collapse, then port back in; every rotation does Lord damage
